title: Joka Beatz comes together with Shanna Hustle to deliver his recent song  "Love Ain’t Enuff"
htmlContent:
Emerging music star Joka Beatz is a multi-talented artist and producer who has taken his time to learn about his craft. Joka Beatz comes together with Shanna Hustle to deliver a must-hear sound titled "Love Ain't Enuff."

Joka Beatz Ft Shanna Hustle's "Love Ain’t Enuff" is a soulful ballad performed by Shanna Hustle alongside her Angelic voice & melodic rhythms and then produced by Joka Beatz. They both demonstrate excellence in every aspect of their game. Her high-powered flow and hard lyrics that pack a punch are delivered masterfully to make this track a gem you must find now.
